import math

def egyptian_fraction(num, den):
    parts = []
    while num:
        unit = math.ceil(den / num)
        parts.append(unit)
        num, den = num * unit - den, den * unit
        g = math.gcd(num, den) or 1
        num, den = num // g, den // g
    return parts

parts = egyptian_fraction(6, 14)
print(" + ".join(f"1/{u}" for u in parts))
